paragraphs: First, go to the production line and follow the workers to record the working hours of each process and mark the bottleneck stations; go back to the office and draw a line balance diagram to calculate which stations need to be merged or rearranged; take the plan to the site to explain to the squad leader, and test it again after making the changes to verify the improvement; enter the standard working hours and maintenance into the MES, and retest regularly to prevent rebound.
